title: Install Patrol — personal notes
content:
2026-03-12 morning — quick field brain-dump for NorthStar Financial (staging rack 3B)

Top-of-mind: slow tokenization issues on node-02 after runtime restart; likely NVMe metadata contention. Need to confirm with diskstats and iostat.

Morning checklist (short):
- [ ] verify jumpbox key rotation (checked keys on jumpbox-1)
- [x] confirm firewall ports (443, 1194, 2379) open to control-plane subnets
- [ ] stage offline image bundle to /opt/offline/redwood-images.tgz on all nodes
- [ ] validate that internal docker registry mirror responds on 10.40.5.8:5000
- [ ] run quick smoke: curl -sS http://localhost:8080/health on all redwood-agent pods

Customer env notes (handy):
- CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16 (customer-managed), DC uplink to cloud: 198.51.100.0/24
- Jumpbox: ubuntu20-jump-1 (10.40.5.10) — use bastion key maya_northstar
- Rack: Staging 3B, cabinet U24–U29, labeled NS-3B on door
- Power: A-side PDUs configured, B-side on maintenance schedule (avoid B feed between 14:00–15:00 PST)
- Switches: TOR Dell-S5248 (mgmt 10.40.0.2) — default MTU 1500, Qsfp ports set to 10G

Observed problems and quick hypotheses:
1) tokenization latency spike after k8s node reboot (node-02)
   - symptom: steady-state requests slow for first 30s then recover
   - logs: rediscache miss floods at startup, KV cache warming takes time
   - hypothesis: corrupted KV checkpoint on disk -> agent falling back to full recompute
   - immediate: rename /var/lib/redwood/kv-checkpoint.*.bak and restart redwood-agent; if still bad, restore from s3-stage (s3://ns-staging/redwood/kv-checkpoints/2026-03-11.tgz)

2) intermittent TLS handshake failures from control-plane to node-04
   - symptom: cert verify failed: unknown CA
   - notes: customer is running a site CA; root cert expired 2026-02-28 (they replaced with intermediate but forgot chain)
   - action: ask Lina to push new chain to /etc/ssl/local-ca.crt and restart kubelet (graceful)

Commands I keep typing (save me):
- ssh -i ~/.ssh/maya_northstar ubuntu@10.40.5.10 -A
- scp /opt/offline/redwood-images.tgz ubuntu@10.40.5.10:/tmp/
- tar -xzf /tmp/redwood-images.tgz -C /var/lib/redwood/images
- sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent redwood-runtime
- kubectl -n redwood get pods -o wide | egrep "redwood-agent|control-plane"

Config reminders:
- kubelet: --resolv-conf=/run/systemd/resolve/resolv.conf on customer nodes (note: they use systemd-resolved)
- docker daemon: registry-mirror http://10.40.5.8:5000, insecure-allowed true for mirror only
- ephemeral storage: tmpfs /var/lib/redwood/kv-cache size=8G (set in systemd unit drop-in)
- ulimit: nofile 200000 for redwood-agent process (we saw EMFILE during batch spikes)

Offline packaging checklist (for air-gapped):
- images: platform:sha256:3712 built locally, tag mirror:10.40.5.8/redwood/platform:3712
- artifacts: /opt/offline/third-party-deps.tar.gz (python wheel archive)
- scripts: network-setup.sh (MTU, routes), cert-import.sh (place CA chain), ntp-setup.sh (chrony conf)

Open blockers (owner + next step):
- Blocker: customer firewall blocks outbound to S3 for artifact restore (INF-8421) — Owner: Ethan Cho — Next: get temporary proxy endpoint (vpn-proxy.ns) approved by customer sec
- Blocker: node-03 GPU driver mismatch (host has nvidia 535.54, runtime expects 535.50) — Owner: Maya Thompson (me) — Next: coordinate with infra night window to upgrade driver (ETA 2026-03-13 02:00)
- Blocker: too many pods in CrashLoopBackOff on node-05 after node drain (cause unknown) — Owner: Lina Rodriguez — Next: collect /var/log/containers logs and check image pull errors

Quick debugging tips for this site (notes to self):
- If SSH sessions drop after ~60s, check TCP keepalive on the jumpbox (ClientAliveInterval)
- For odd packet loss, set MTU to 9000 only after verifying trunk supports jumbo frames end-to-end
- If redwood-agent fails to mount tmpfs, check systemd drop-in path: /etc/systemd/system/redwood-agent.service.d/tmpfs.conf
- When pulling from the mirror and a 403 occurs, verify mirror credentials file: /etc/redwood/registry-creds.json (mirror user is 'ns-mirror')

Post-deploy TODO (today / this sprint):
- validate rolling upgrade strategy: canary percent 10% -> 25% -> 50% with automatic fallback on error rate > 2%
- write short runbook for KV warming after restart (steps + expected timeline)
- check with customer Sec about bringing in HSM for key wrap (they asked about BYOK)

Random jot/journal:
- Spent 20m on phone with site network lead (Samir) — good contact. He prefers email: samir@northstar.local (not yet added to tenant list).
- Remember to add offline package checksum to ticket INF-8421 before sending bundle.

End notes: keep this doc live during the visit. Convert important items into tickets before handing over to L3. If I don't resolve the GPU drift tonight, escalate to infra oncall and add a mitigation: route heavy workloads to dedicated pool (redwood-dedicated-staging)

-- Maya
